title: The warship that sank on day one
summary: In 1628 Sweden's new warship Vasa capsized minutes into its maiden voyage. The Baltic's brackish water preserved it so well that today the ship is about 95% original.

scenes.text: Sweden's mightiest warship sank on its very first voyage.
On 10 August 1628, the Vasa sailed only about 1,300 metres before a gust made it heel over. Water poured in through the open gunports.

scenes.text: The cold, brackish Baltic water had a surprising effect.
scenes.reveal: Shipworms couldn't thrive there. Today the ship is about 95% original.

scenes.text: A spectacular failure became the world's best-preserved 17th-century ship.
